content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To make flavored hummus, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Pulse the mixture until smooth (2 minutes)
Step 2. Arrange garnishes on top (3 minutes)
Step 3. Sort through dried chickpeas (10 minutes)
Step 4. Clean the food processor bowl (5 minutes)
Step 5. Transfer hummus to a serving bowl (2 minutes)
Step 6. Taste and adjust seasoning (1 minute)
Step 7. Mince fresh parsley (4 minutes)
Step 8. Soak chickpeas in water (12 hours)
Step 9. Peel the skins off the cooked chickpeas (30 minutes)
Step 10. Measure out the tahini (1 minute)
Step 11. Squeeze fresh lemon juice (2 minutes)
Step 12. Measure out the olive oil (1 minute)
Step 13. Whisk tahini and lemon juice together (3 minutes)
Step 14. Drain the cooking liquid into a jar (2 minutes)
Step 15. Emulsify oil and tahini (2 minutes)
Step 16. Add salt and cumin (30 seconds)
Step 17. Add minced garlic to the bowl (1 minute)
Step 18. Roast red peppers for flavoring (20 minutes)
Step 19. Find the citrus juicer (2 minutes)
Step 20. Place chickpeas into the processor (1 minute)
Step 21. Peel the garlic cloves (2 minutes)
Step 22. Add ice cubes for fluffiness (30 seconds)
Step 23. Add tahini mixture to the chickpeas (1 minute)
Step 24. Wash the fresh herbs (3 minutes)
Step 25. Preheat the oven for roasting (10 minutes)
Step 26. Buy all necessary ingredients at the store (1 hour)
Step 27. Remove charred skins from peppers (5 minutes)
Step 28. Take out the heavy cooking pot (1 minute)
Step 29. Fill the pot with fresh water (1 minute)
Step 30. Set out the food processor (2 minutes)
Step 31. Boil the chickpeas with baking soda (1 hour)
Step 32. Rinse the soaked chickpeas (2 minutes)
Step 33. Puree the roasted peppers (3 minutes)
Step 34. Prepare the ice bath for cooling (4 minutes)
Step 35. Inspect the chickpeas for debris (5 minutes)
Step 36. Simmer the chickpeas until very tender (45 minutes)
Step 37. Dice the roasted peppers (5 minutes)
Step 38. Assemble the processor blades (1 minute)
Step 39. Sanitize the kitchen counter (10 minutes)
Step 40. Cook the chickpeas on high heat (50 minutes)
